title: We're back
caption:
It's been a while. Some of you bought or sold property with us years ago, and some of you followed this page and then heard nothing.

I stepped back from real estate to focus on my career in IT, risk and audit. I learned a lot there, especially one rule: check everything before you trust it.

Now I'm back, and that rule is how Real Estate Matchmakers will work from today. Every home and plot we show you will have its title, survey and price checked first. No fake listings, no surprises after you pay.

Homes and land in Lagos and Abuja, for buyers here and abroad. If you're looking, or you know someone who is, send me a message. It's good to be back.

#RealEstateMatchmakers #WereBack #LagosRealEstate #AbujaRealEstate #PropertyInNigeria

title: Know your papers (carousel)
caption:
Most property problems in Nigeria start with papers the buyer didn't understand.

Here are 3 titles you'll hear about all the time: C of O, R of O and Governor's Consent. Swipe through, save this post, and send it to anyone who's about to buy.

title: How we verify (carousel)
caption:
Every property we show you has been through these 5 checks first. No exceptions.

Title document. Registry search. Survey and charting. Physical inspection. Clean paperwork.

It takes us longer. It saves you from the stories everyone has heard about land sold twice, fake documents and agents who disappear.

That's what "We check it before you buy it" means.

title: Buying from abroad (carousel)
caption:
Buying property back home from the UK, US, Canada or anywhere else?

Distance is exactly what fraudsters count on. These are the 4 rules we follow for every client abroad: see it live, search first, pay the right account, use a lawyer.

We do live video inspections for every diaspora buyer. Send us a message and tell us what you're looking for.
